title: Seattle Seahawks vs. Denver Broncos Postgame Analysis: What Happened, What We Got Right and What We Learned
seo_title: Seattle Seahawks 14-17 Denver Broncos: EdgeDesk Postgame Thesis Audit
excerpt: Denver Broncos won 17-14. The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.
seo_description: Denver Broncos beat Seattle Seahawks 17-14. EdgeDesk’s number implied Denver Broncos +2 — win. 5 of 11 gradeable claims held up, 6 did not. Process grade: MIXED. Research, not picks.
model_status_note: The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.
author: EdgeDesk Research
research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 79 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.
market_source: The sportsbook number on this page is a quote EdgeDesk captured at BetOnline.ag on 2026-10-10, replayed from a committed snapshot rather than read live. reasons: 5 claims held up, 0 held up in direction only and 4 did not. Parts of the read were right and parts were not.
The result carries 1 high-variance marker — a 3-turnover swing — so the scoreboard is weaker evidence than it looks.
EdgeDesk projected a away margin of 0.1 and the game finished 3 the home way — 3.1 points of margin error, inside the range the model published.
process.basis: the drivers, matchups and measured advantages only — never the price or the market claim, which are the result in longer words

variance_markers.label: A 3-turnover swing
variance_markers.text: Denver Broncos won the turnover battle by 3. Turnover margin is the least repeatable thing in football: it moves scoreboards hard and predicts almost nothing about the next meeting, so a result built on it says less about either team than the scoreline suggests.

variance_markers.label: A 3-point game
variance_markers.text: A game this close is decided inside the noise of any projection. Whichever way it fell, it is weak evidence about either team.

verdict.line: The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.

grading.separation_note: The bet result and the process grade above are computed separately and are allowed to disagree. A winning number with a broken thesis is recorded as exactly that.
